title: MCP Tool Config
description: The unsafe MCP tools need to be able to be enabled/disabled individually. Default on unless very dangerous

comments.author: AgentSmith
comments.body: Implemented per-tool MCP enable/disable configuration. Added MemorySmith:Mcp:EnabledTools and DisabledTools, exposed both in Admin settings, routed /mcp tools/list and tools/call through the configuration, preserved the existing default-on MCP surface via descriptor-level defaults, and documented the behavior in README plus API/MCP/configuration wiki pages. Validation passed: focused disabled-tool regression and existing MCP tools/list/schema tests passed 4/4; broader McpAndSemanticSearchTests, ChatToolCatalogAndInterceptTests, SecurityAndSourceLinkTests, and SemanticToolQualityTests slice passed 51/51; Scripts/Test-TaskRecords.ps1 passed over 170 task records.
